Specsight turns code changes into a living product map, feature knowledge, and clear release updates. Keep Product, Sales, and Support in sync with what your software actually does and what changed.

productLaunches.title: telemetry.dev
productLaunches.description: LLM observability for AI agents - telemetry.dev shows each run of your AI agent as one trace. Each model call and tool call is a span with its duration, tokens, cost, and error. Prompts and evals use the same traces: change a prompt without a deploy, then run it on a dataset and compare the scores with production. Alerts tell you about errors, cost spikes, and agent loops. Connect with our TypeScript or Python SDK, or with the OpenTelemetry exporter that you already use.

productLaunches.title: Backenly
productLaunches.description: The autonomous backend for AI coding agents - Backenly is an autonomous backend platform built for coding agents. Your agent builds the backend over MCP, from Postgres to sign-in, storage, functions and realtime. Then it maintains itself: every minute a self-healing loop repairs missing indexes, RLS gaps and dead realtime triggers, verifying each fix live. As your app grows, it restructures its own schema once you approve. Risky changes wait for you, and every change is versioned with rollback.

productLaunches.title: WinnerAdSpy
productLaunches.description: Turn competitor ad insights into winning app campaigns - Winneradspy is an ad creative intelligence platform built specifically for mobile app and game marketers. Explore 20M+ ad creatives across 200K+ apps, uncover winning hooks, visuals, messaging and CTAs, and track competitor campaigns with real-time alerts. Unlike generic ad spy tools, it scores creatives as Winner, Loser or Learning, helping UA managers, growth teams and agencies understand what works and build better campaigns. Query ad insights through ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini via MCP.
